reason: B offers the more physically grounded and decisive test of a dislocation-mediated high-temperature plasticity mechanism, with direct dislocation-character measurements and an alloy control, although its extrapolation from NbTaTiV to HfNbTaTiZr and its explanation of thermal expansion are weak. A relies on the poorly supported premise that heating induces short-range order that increases distortion, and its temperature-only comparison cannot separate ordering effects from ordinary anharmonic thermal softening and expansion.
